record.Description: This recall involves Mochi Malrang Mystery Dumpling Toys. The mystery dumpling toys are a translucent red color, containing glitter and water beads. The toys have a cartoon face and are packaged in a tan plastic container shaped like a bamboo steamer. The phrases "SOFT and SQUISHY" and "MOCHI MALRANG" are visible on the front of the removable package labeling. There are no markings on the product, other than the cartoon face.
record.Title: LLK Trading Recalls Mochi Malrang Mystery Dumpling Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Water Bead Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
record.ConsumerContact: LLK Trading by email at llktradinginc@gmail.com.

Distributors.Name: LLK Trading Inc., of Vernon, California

Hazards.Name: The mystery dumpling toys violate the mandatory safety standard for toys because the water beads inside the dumplings expand larger than permitted, posing a deadly ingestion hazard. If a water bead is ingested, it can pose ingestion, choking, and intestinal obstruction hazards inside a child's body, resulting in severe discomfort, vomiting, dehydration and a risk of death to a child.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the mystery dumpling toys immediately and contact LLK Trading for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write "RECALLED" in permanent marker on the squeezy dumpling and its tan plastic container, throw them away, and email a photo of the items in the trash to llktradinginc@gmail.com.

ai.summary: LLK Trading has recalled around 480 Mochi Malrang Mystery Dumpling Toys because the water beads inside them can expand beyond legal safety limits. If swallowed by a child, these beads pose life-threatening risks of choking and internal blockages.
ai.next_steps: Consumers should immediately take these toys away from children and reach out to LLK Trading to get a full refund. To complete the process, mark "RECALLED" in permanent marker on both the dumpling and its tan plastic container, throw them in the trash, and email a photo of the discarded items to llktradinginc@gmail.com.
